name: Inequality-Adjusted Human Development Index
notes: Columns ihdi_2010 through ihdi_2023 (14 years). Only available from 2010 onwards.

name: Gender Inequality Index
notes: Columns gii_1990 through gii_2023. Exclude gii_rank_{year} columns via digit-only suffix filter.

name: Inequality in Income (Atkinson measure)
notes: Columns ineq_inc_2010 through ineq_inc_2023. Prefix contains underscore; handled by startswith+isdigit check.

name: Multidimensional Poverty Index
notes: OPHI Table 6 (Trends Over Time) XLSX. 88 countries, 2 time points each (t0/t1, survey-year cadence 2001-2024). Sheet '6.1 Harmonised MPI' (sheet 0 = readme only). Header at Excel row 5 (0-indexed 4); data starts at row 8 (4 sub-header rows to skip). Wide format: ISO-3 in col[1], t0 MPI in col[8], t1 MPI in col[9], t0 survey year in col[5], t1 survey year in col[7]. Survey years like '2015-2016' resolved to end year. Requires openpyxl.
